messages:
nina: Heads-up — BetaNet saw ~30m of inference failures during their staging run this morning. Symptoms look like intermittent packet drops on their edge circuit to our US-west colo. They’re scheduled to go live tomorrow and want an architecture/mitigation checklist ASAP.
marcus: Can you paste the logs or a span? what region/colo?
nina: Attaching the customer excerpt (they redacted IPs). Topline: spike in TCP retransmits, backend connections reset, many requests retried and hit short-circuit fallback to smaller model.
olivia: Thanks — sounds like two orthogonal things: 1) network flakiness causing request retries and 2) overload behavior triggering fallback. Suggest quick audit: routing policy, retry/backoff settings, and a short-term model-routing override for BetaNet.
jessica_partner: We need a customer-facing script to calm them down. ETA on a fallback plan? They’re anxious.
eric: I can run a tracing sweep on our side for BetaNet tenant IDs, can we get the exact tenant prefix? also curious if prefix-sharding mapping put them on a single node.
marcus: @nina please confirm tenant prefix. Also what’s their configured retry policy? default is 3x with exponential backoff, which could amplify transient network issues.
nina: Tenant prefix sent to @eric via DM. Their retry policy is default. They used Dedicated Reserved pool in us-west-2 with two nodes behind the LB.
tom_net: From the partner side: their colo link is flapping between two circuits; vendor is already scheduling a maintenance window tonight. Short term we can recommend: 1) enable sticky routing to spread sessions, 2) reduce aggressive retries, 3) pre-warm a third node in the pool.
olivia: Proposal (quick action):
- Turn off client-side aggressive retries (ask partner to set 0-1)
- Set Redwood routing policy for BetaNet to prefer us-east as failover (policy override)
- Pre-warm an extra dedicated node for 2 hours before go-live
- Shorten batch window to 40ms for BetaNet to reduce head-of-line blocking

We can put the routing override in the console per-customer under partnerships>overrides.
katie_cs: I’ll draft the customer note: explain what we’re doing and timeline, include rollback steps.
eric: I’ll run a KV-cache/placement check and trace for retries — give me until +30m. If we see single-node hotness we’ll rotate shard mapping.
sam-bot: incident created: INC-21790012 — BetaNet staging failures. Pager duty alerted (oncall: eric).
jessica_partner: Okay, as long as we have a clear short-term failover and a rollback, they’ll be happy. I’ll confirm the partner’s maintenance window and ask them to throttle retries.
marcus: Postmortem steps for after go-live: collect p50/p95 latency, retry counts, and model-fallback rates for the BetaNet tenant for first 6h. Also sanity-check telemetry retention for that tenant.
olivia: Action owners: olivia (routing override + batch change), eric (tracing + placement), tom_net (confirm colo maintenance + circuit timeline), katie_cs (customer comms), marcus (postmortem template). We’ll reconvene in 45m in #partnerships with state update.
nina: Thank you everyone — I’ll coordinate with BetaNet PM and post updates here.
_meta: Generated Slack thread for SI delivery support: customer arch review + implementation escalation. Single-thread format per agents.md requirements.
